title: Lumosite
description: It adds a Lumosite Ore, Lumosite Shard, and Lumosite Ingot.
body: Lumosite is a light-themed expansion mod that adds glowing ore, powerful tools, and a friendly companion. Explore caves to find rare Lumosite Ore and smelt shards into bright ingots. This small but polished mod brings utility, glow effects, and a magical atmosphere to your Minecraft world.
